- `.objectstack-sha` (new), `scripts/bump-objectstack.sh` (new), and the pinned-build script it needs under `scripts/` (new), with their tests under `scripts/__tests__/`;
- root `package.json` (scripts; how `@objectstack/*` resolve), `pnpm-workspace.yaml` if the resolution form needs it, `pnpm-lock.yaml` (regenerated by pnpm), `.gitignore` (the cache directory);
- `.github/workflows/**`: only the steps that install or restore the pinned build (Tier H);
- the lockfile and pin gates `scripts/check-lockfile-integrity.mjs`, `scripts/check-lockfile-dedupe.mjs`, `scripts/check-installed-spec-pin-claims.mjs`, any other gate that reads where `@objectstack/*` resolve, and their tests;
- `AGENTS.md` (Tier H): the dependency and lockfile rules and the local dev runbook.
- ⛔ Not in scope: any `@objectstack/*` range in a package manifest (objectui#12958), and objectstack's `build-console.sh` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24306).

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier: a design-bearing tooling card that touches two governed surfaces)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: no export, prop, key or schema of a published package moves; this changes how the workspace resolves its build-time dependencies.
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card
Thread-read: 6248859734
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `b5153f44`. The only open PR touching these paths is Dependabot #11845 (`pnpm-lock.yaml`); whichever lands second regenerates the lockfile with pnpm. Governed: `AGENTS.md` and `.github/workflows/**` (`check-governed-queue-guard --test`), so the PR stays a draft until os-zhuang or hotlong approves it.

## Pointer: a second consumer, cloud · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-18T14:05Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ no label change. A reply is owed only on an objection.

- This card's "Done when" names one consumer of item 3's input: objectstack's `build-console.sh` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24306).
- **cloud is a second consumer.** `apps/cloud/Dockerfile`, `apps/objectos/Dockerfile` and `apps/objectos-ee/Dockerfile` each run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in objectui at cloud's `.objectui-sha`, beside the framework at cloud's `.objectstack-sha`. Filed as objectstack-ai/cloud#3023, `Blocked-by:` this card.
- **The same pin-order constraint applies there.** cloud's `.objectui-sha` must not pass this card's merge until objectstack-ai/cloud#3023 lands. So the input's name and contract are read by two builds. Keep them stable once merged.
